readme:
# Prettier - Code formatter

Formats your code with [Prettier](https://prettier.io): Format Document (`Ctrl+K Ctrl+E`), Format Selection (`Ctrl+K Ctrl+F`), and format-on-save through `editor.formatOnSave`.

This is the formatter for the languages no language server covers in Diode — Markdown, JSON, YAML, CSS/LESS/SCSS, HTML — as well as for JavaScript and TypeScript.

Prettier itself ships inside the extension, so it works with no setup. When your project has its own `prettier` in `node_modules`, that one is used instead, and `.prettierrc` / `.editorconfig` are picked up from the workspace.

This is the unmodified extension published on Open VSX, pinned to a specific version and verified to work in Diode.

## What works in Diode

Formatting end to end: the whole document or the selection, on every language Prettier supports, with configuration resolved the same way as in VS Code. The status bar shows the formatter state and `Prettier: Open Output` (or clicking the entry) shows what it did.

## What does not

`Prettier: Create Configuration File` opens a folder picker to choose where to write `.prettierrc` — Diode has no folder-picker dialog yet, so the command does nothing. Write the config file by hand instead.

Diode has no `editor.defaultFormatter` and no "Format Document With…" picker, so when two extensions offer a formatter for the same language the first one registered wins. In practice that means Prettier formats TypeScript and JavaScript, not the built-in TypeScript server. If you want the TypeScript formatter back on those files, uninstall Prettier.
